id.description: Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123ABC) — pass to cdp-functions inputs.channel.

name.description: Slack channel name without the leading '#'.

is_private.description: True if the channel is private.

is_member.description: True if the PostHog Slack app is a member of the channel and can post to it.

is_ext_shared.description: True if the channel is shared with another Slack workspace.

is_private_without_access.description: True if the channel is private and the PostHog Slack app cannot access it.
